QuestInfo.name: Camila's Lost Letter
QuestInfo.parent: Looking for the Korean Folk Town...
QuestInfo.0: Apparently, Camila of Henesys lost something...
QuestInfo.1: She was devastated that her friend, who lives far from here, sent her a letter, only to be stolen by the notorious Curse Eye's. She was crying as she asked me for help. I may have to find the letter for the sake of Camila, but where is that girl?\n\n#t4031239# #b#c4031239##k/1
QuestInfo.2: I recovered Camila's letter that had been stolen from the Curse Eye's. It should be fun writing letters to people far from me...

0.0: 어쩌면 좋지? 중요한 편지를 잃어버렸어요. 숲에 사는 심술궂은 커즈아이들이 내 편지를 가져가버렸어. 그 편지는 먼 마을에 사는 펜팔친구가 보내 준 소중한 편지인데.. 이젠 어쩌지? 커즈아이들이 가져 간 제 편지를 찾아와 주세요. 흑흑..

What should I do? I lost a very important letter. A menacing group of Curse Eyes from the forest got a hold of it! It's an important letter written to me by a pen pal from far way. What should I do? Please help me get the letter back from those coward Curse Eyes! (cries)

yes.0: Thank you so much. I'll be here waiting for your good news.

no.0: Man... What am I going to do now...?

1.0: Hey, you found my letter! Thank you so much! I thought I'd never live to see the day...

item.0: Is it really difficult to find that letter?
